mitre_attack_chain.description: Evidence-to-TTP Matrix: each technique MUST cite a behavior anchor from Phase 1

technique_id.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (e.g. T1190, T1071.001)

exact_behavior_anchor.description: MUST be an exact string from Phase 1's mandatory_behaviors. If no match exists, DO NOT include this technique.

textual_evidence.description: Quote from CVE description/references supporting this mapping

attack_confidence.description: Confidence level for the entire attack chain mapping
